# External Data

## Indian railway station coordinates

- Source: Geo-referenced Indian Railways Data
- Author: Sankalp Sharma
- Gist: https://gist.github.com/sankalpsharmaa/0c0587f3ae31277411960f70128d682f
- Raw file: https://gist.githubusercontent.com/sankalpsharmaa/0c0587f3ae31277411960f70128d682f/raw/075361e1625bac0e8138dfbc68880c639d871e7b/india_railway_stations.geojson

The gist preview describes station point coordinates and railway network
coordinates in GeoJSON format. I did not find an explicit license in the gist
preview, so verify redistribution rights before publishing this dataset or a
derived build artifact.

## Indian railway train names

- Source: Indian Railway Train Numbers & Names.json
- Author: jraavis
- Gist: https://gist.github.com/jraavis/5274d998916131dd48e76879a1dc6076
- Raw file: https://gist.githubusercontent.com/jraavis/5274d998916131dd48e76879a1dc6076/raw/Indian%20Railway%20Train%20Numbers%20%26%20Names.json

This optional enrichment file maps train numbers to cleaner display names. The
source timetable names are preserved in generated JSON as `sourceName` or
`sourceTrainName`. I did not find an explicit license in the gist preview, so
verify redistribution rights before publishing this dataset or a derived build
artifact.
